title: Nico and the Unhurried Notes
youtube_title: Nico and the Unhurried Notes | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience turns a jumble of notes into a tune that people can follow.
summary: Nico practices a simple recorder tune for the town music corner, but the notes tangle when he hurries. He slows his fingers, plays only the ready phrase, and joins the soft music without rushing.
